BLANK NOT FILLED, deliberately. SEARCH LOG (identical exhaustive pass behind every unit on this row; the row-specific finding is that NO source anywhere I can reach names this segment). (a) All four dominant_documents read in full from bodies I fetched and extracted myself: the petrobest contractor project page, the provincial gas plan 赣发改规划[2014]325号 (via the qianzhan PDF), the 2025-04-03 SSE bond tracking report for 江西省投资集团, and the 2022 CCXI credit report for 江西省天然气集团 -- 奉新 and 赤岗 occur ZERO times in the SSE, CCXI and soultnuts documents (grep -c), and petrobest's Phase I paragraph ('江西省天然气管网一期工程：干线总长度876公里...2010年省天然气管网一期工程全线贯通') names no 奉新/赤岗. The ONLY 奉新 in the 2014 provincial plan is in Table 5's 72-segment list of NEW/PLANNED provincial segments (~2,260 km): '石鼻阀室一奉新 16' km -- 石鼻镇 is in 安义县, i.e. the plan's own analogue of an Anyi-county-to-Fengxin branch, listed as still to be built as of 2014 and under a different endpoint name and a different length (16 vs 18.45 km). (b) All 25 harvest_pool_live URLs opened this session with a browser UA and Accept-Language: zh-CN -- all HTTP 200. 奉新 appears in only four: the two jiangxi.gov.cn /art/ pages, which are this batch's known soft-404 shell (identical 48,138-byte body, <title>404 - 江西省人民政府</title>, the same negative P5859/P5886 recorded); the archive.org item screenshot-2024-10-03-at-5.08.57-pm, whose caption is '干洲-奉新支线' -- that is P5863's row, and the item is a GEM researcher's own upload, uncitable under standing rule 1; and sohu.com/a/466792472_661255, a provincial major-project roster whose 奉新 entries are a ring road and a pumped-storage plant. 赤岗 appears in NONE of the 25. (c) A full-text TITLE SWEEP of the Jiangxi public-resource trading platform (www.jxsggzy.cn -- the province's mandatory tender-disclosure channel), driven through the platform's own search API which I reverse-engineered from its js (POST /XZinterface/rest/esinteligentsearch/getFullTextDataNew, fields=title, inc_wd as the AND operator): 1,097 gas-network notices, 1,013 unique titles, 2016-11 -> 2025-02, naming ~39 sibling branches at segment level. 奉新 = 0, 赤岗 = 0, 干洲 = 0, 石鼻 = 0. 安义 appears in exactly two projects, neither this one (安义-靖安支线 勘察设计, and the 二期 安义、昌北改造 procurement). Secondary sweeps: 奉新+天然气 = 16 hits, all false friends (city-distribution and unrelated county works); 奉新+燃气 = 9, city distribution only; 奉新门站 / 奉新分输 / 干洲+天然气 = 0. CAVEAT recorded honestly: the platform's gas coverage starts 2016-11, so it cannot disprove a 2011-2013 build -- it can only show that a branch that was operating since 2013 generated no maintenance, verification, or reconstruction notice in nine subsequent years, while every other operating Phase I branch did. (d) Discovery channels available: WebSearch was UNAVAILABLE for this row (the session's 200-call budget was exhausted before my turn), so everything above is direct host crawling. Baidu returns its 百度安全验证 bot-check, Sogou/so.com 302 to bot shells, Bing's RSS returns wholly unrelated cached results for the CJK query. fengxin.gov.cn and yichun.gov.cn site search is a Vue SPA (/chatqa/#/search) whose api/qa/outerNet/search POST 302s to the homepage without a token I cannot obtain. ACCESS FAILURES (kept as such, never treated as evidence): jczh.com/notice/58796 (a 2023 maintenance-tender lead) serves an Aliyun CF_APP_WAF interstitial with a 412-byte body, Wayback CDX returns [] (no capture at all), and r.jina.ai returns Cloudflare 403; strq.jxngh.com (the operator's own site, and the wiki's Diameter source) connect-times-out (HTTP 000) on /, /gsgk/ and /gsyw/359.htm even with curl -4.

Every cost figure in this document set is an aggregate and RELAUNCH_NOTES item 3 forbids staging any of them on a segment cell: sohu 2008 '项目总投资近26亿元' (whole Phase I programme incl. CNG mother stations), sina 2011 '预计总投资31亿元' (same programme, later vintage), CCXI 2022 fn3 '总投资 62.49 亿元' (the whole ~1,500 km Phase II build), 2,172,600,000 CNY (the four Ganzhou-south branches together). No 核准批复 or EIA package exists for 奉新支线 to give a project-level number, because no document names the project. A cost of an unattested segment would be a fabrication, not a fill.

verifications.note: url_verifier --name '奉新' OK 2026-09-10. READ, NOT STAGED. 赣发改规划[2014]325号 Table 5 lists '石鼻阀室一奉新 16' km among the province's 72 PLANNED new segments, which would make 2014 the earliest year at which an Anyi-to-Fengxin branch demonstrably exists as a named provincial project. I am not staging it as this row's ProposalYear because the plan's segment carries a different origin name (石鼻阀室, not 赤岗) and a different length (16 vs 18.45 km), and because a 2014 proposal year would sit AFTER this row's recorded 2011 construction and 2013 in-service dates -- i.e. staging it would quietly assert that the row's other dates are wrong, which is the __VALIDITY__ record's question, not a fill.
